pairs.summary: STAT1 and ZNF76 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 14 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; ...). Median lift 1.52x, typical spacing ~52 bp between sites. In 14 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. It is enriched in most profiles, so it may reflect general sequence composition of accessible DNA rather than context-specific cooperation. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only; ChromBPNet contribution scores did not highlight both sites (2 profile(s) tested); no significant ablation synergy. RNA layer (donor-aware within-donor metacell r): HepG2 (hepatocyte, proxy match): CELLxGENE no significant co-expression, Tabula Sapiens no significant co-expression; K562 (erythroid myeloid progenitor, proxy match): CELLxGENE no significant co-expression, Tabula Sapiens no significant co-expression.

CCLA_K562.mapping_note: proxy: K562 (CML erythroleukemia line) -> normal erythroid/MEP/CMP progenitors
